law: transform / opacity / clip-path only. A transition or animation on a layout property costs layout + paint every frame on the main thread; a size change belongs to the layout kernel (graphics/motion/react/runtime/layout).

grammar.declaration: from a `transition` or `transition-property` property name to the next `;` or `}`, newlines included
grammar.segments: the value is split on commas at depth 0 (a comma inside var()/cubic-bezier() does not split)
grammar.reported: the FIRST token of a segment when it is a layout property or `all`; plus any segment reading a pre-composed --ds-transition-* alias whose expansion declares a layout property

countingUnit: one site = one (file, line, kind, property). A single declaration with two layout legs is two sites; the debrief's per-declaration estimate is therefore lower than this roster by construction.

termWeights.note: Measured on this corpus with this counting unit, by the drill beside this file. Both terms are load-bearing; the grammar is the larger, which is why it is frozen before the count. Re-measured 2026-09-29 over the drained corpus (7a79c1b89 retired the one direct transition:all): frozen 68 -> 67, single-line 11 -> 10, kebab-only 30 -> 29; both worths unchanged. The debrief's 16/1 decomposition was taken over src/** with a per-declaration unit and a different widening -- not comparable, and not carried forward.

knownBlindSpots.evidence: 11 `--ds-<component>-transition: all var(...)` channel declarations under presentation/components/**, one per owner listed above. The DECLARATION is a channel definition, not an applied transition, and the READ names no layout property at the call site, so neither the frozen grammar nor Arm A can see it.
knownBlindSpots.correction: An earlier revision of this file said 12. That figure came from a looser `transition:\s*all` grep over the whole stylesheet tree, which also swept in `runtime/engines/modern/framework-bridge/index.css:63` -- a DIRECT `transition: all 0.2s ease`, a different class that was the roster's single `transitionAll` row until 7a79c1b89 (WO-RET-02 packet 1) drained it with the bridge shrink (the class is now empty; the anti-return pin lives in the drill). The two classes are counted separately; the drill measures `pattern` over `scanRoot` MINUS the baseline exclusions -- the facade/artifacts mirrors carry 5 generated copies per vertical and counting them would read one authority as two (the drill missed the exclusion filter until 2026-09-29 and read 26 where the source sheets carry 11).
knownBlindSpots.disposition: OUT of this roster on purpose. The closed alias map is `--ds-transition-*` only (the adopted ruling); widening it to per-component channels would mint a second authority for `which channel expands to a layout property` that can drift from the sheets. Owner: the property-law drain programme, which is not this lot.
